paper.title_en: Integrable Singularity Black Holes without Inner Horizons in Asymptotically Safe Inspired Gravity and NFW Dark Matter Effects
paper.abstract_en: We investigate an alternative ultraviolet (UV) structure for Renormalization Group improved (RG) black holes within a phenomenological framework inspired by asymptotically safe gravity. In several regular RG constructions, regularity at the origin is associated with a dS core and an additional inner horizon, raising issues of spacetime predictability and possible mass inflation instabilities. Motivated by this problem, we relate the RG scale to the radially weighted effective quantum gravitational source entering the volume integrand of the quantum corrected Ricci scalar. This prescription yields a Bessel type running Newton coupling with $G_I(r)\sim r$ in the UV, rather than the usual $G(r)\sim r^3$ behavior, and supports an integrable central singularity. The inner branch is matched through the Israel Darmois conditions to an exterior RG solution with $G_{II}\to G_0$ in the infrared, where $G_0$ is the Newton constant. Within the numerical range investigated, the resulting geometry has a single event horizon and no additional inner horizon. We then incorporate an NFW dark matter distribution coupled to the same running coupling. Since $ρ_{\rm NFW}\sim r^{-1}$ while $G_I(r)\sim r$ near the origin, the effective matter contribution entering the field equations remains finite, producing a cored effective behavior without modifying the NFW profile by hand. The gravitational decoupling algorithm keeps the quantum gravitational and dark matter sectors separately conserved within the same geometry. For the configurations considered, the NFW sector shifts the event horizon while preserving the single horizon structure. Thus, the same running coupling governs both the integrable UV black hole geometry and the softening of the central gravitational response of the NFW source.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在渐近安全启发下构建RG改进黑洞，采用新的RG标度设定得到Bessel型跑动牛顿耦合与可积中心奇点，并通过Israel-Darmois条件匹配内外解，进一步耦合NFW暗物质分布。属于渐近安全诱导的修正引力/量子改进黑洞研究，理论构造具体、结构清晰，虽非传统MAG或Palatini形式，但契合modified_gravity范畴，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 渐近安全启发引力中无内视界的可积奇点黑洞及NFW暗物质效应
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在一个受渐近安全引力启发的唯象框架内，研究重整化群（RG）改进黑洞的一种替代紫外（UV）结构。在一些正则RG构造中，原点处的正则性伴有一个dS核心和一个额外的内视界，这引发了时空可预测性问题以及可能的质量膨胀不稳定性。受此问题驱动，我们将RG标度与进入量子修正Ricci标量体积被积函数的径向加权有效量子引力源联系起来。这一规定给出Bessel型跑动牛顿耦合，在UV中为$G_I(r)\sim r$，而非通常的$G(r)\sim r^3$行为，并支持一个可积的中心奇点。内部分支通过Israel Darmois条件匹配到红外中$G_{II}\to G_0$的外部RG解，其中$G_0$为牛顿常数。在所研究的数值范围内，所得几何具有单个事件视界且无额外的内视界。随后，我们引入与同一跑动耦合相耦合的NFW暗物质分布。由于在原点附近$\rho_{\rm NFW}\sim r^{-1}$而$G_I(r)\sim r$，进入场方程的有效物质贡献保持有限，产生核化的有效行为，而无需人为修改NFW剖面。引力解耦算法使量子引力部分与暗物质部分在同一几何中分别守恒。对于所考虑的构型，NFW部分移动事件视界，同时保持单视界结构。因此，同一个跑动耦合既支配可积的UV黑洞几何，也支配NFW源中心引力响应的软化。
